tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos skor gyi byung khungs nyer mkho bzhugs/

na mo gu ru/ spyir ston pas chos dpag tu med pa gsungs pa las/ nyan thos kyi don du gsung ba'i sde snod gsum ni/ bsam pa rang don kho na dang*/ sbyor pa nyams len ni/ tshul khrims dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ shes rab gsum las brtsams te/ lta ba gang zag gi bdag med/ spyod pa 'tshe ba med pa/ sgom pa zhi lhag gi rnal 'byor rnams ston/ brtson 'grus rab kyis bsgoms na/ tshe gsum kyis nyan thos dgra bcom pa dang*/ bskal pa brgyas rang sangs rgyas thob nus pa ni yin/ phar phyin drug la sogs pa ming tsam las ngo bo tshang bar ma bshad/ theg dman gyi sde snod gsum po kho na'i don bsgoms kyang*/ 'dis sangs rgyas kyi lam ma rdzogs pas/ sangs rgyas thob par mi nus so//theg chen la/ mdo dang sngags gnyis las/ mdo pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las/ bsam pa gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems/ spyod pa phar phyin bcu dang bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi/ lta ba bdag med gnyis/ sgom pa rnam par mi rtog pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i gzhi lam 'bras bu rnams shin tu rgyas par ston/ lam 'di kho na bsgoms na bskal pa grangs med gsum nas/ sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi rgyal tshab chen po'i go 'phang thob par nus/ phar phyin rang lam gyis de las lhag po mi thob kyang*/ skabs der sngags la zhugs nas sangs rgyas 'thob bo/ /sngags kyi theg pa la/ bya rgyud/ spyod rgyu/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud de bzhi las/ bya rgyud du ni mdo las ji skad bshad pa'i lam rnams kyi steng du/ chu dang cod pan gyi dbang bskur tsam dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi lha spyan drangs/ mchod pa phul/ dam tshig gi phyag rgyas btab/ sngags bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul ba'i bsnyen pa dang*/ las tshogs sna tshogs pa dang*/ thun mong gi dngos grub mang du sgrub pa'i thabs rgya cher bstan/ rgyud 'di la bdag bskyed med pas/ rje dbon ltar dngos grub len pa'i tha snyad byed/

dka' thub dang gtsang sbra gtso bor spyod/ 'di'i rang lam gyis bskal pa chen po brgyad nas bcu pa 'thob/ spyod rgyud ni phal cher bya rgyud dang 'dra ba las/ dbang gi tshe/ phyag mtshan gyi dbang dang*/ ming dbang yang yod/ nyams len gyi skabs bdag bskyed kyang yod/ grogs po lta bu'i sgo nas dngos grub len/ bskal pa gsum ma ma gcig gis sa bcu thob par 'dod/ bya spyod de gnyis la/ thun mong gi dngos grub kyis tshe bskal pa'i bar du gnas par bsgrubs nas/ rten de la stong nyid snying rje dbyer med mdo dang thun mong ba des 'phags pa'i sa sgrub par 'dod kyi/ mchog gi dngos grub sgrub thabs sngags lam thun mong ma yin pa bshad pa med do/ /rnal 'byor rgyud ni/ spyod rgyud man chad kyi chos rnams yod kyi steng du/ dbang gi skabs/ chu cod pan/ rdo rje dril bu/ ming brtul zhugs/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang*/ rjes gnang sogs mtha' rten rnams dang bcas pa yod cing*/ nyams len gyi skabs/ bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab nas sgom pa dang*/ thun gyi mthar phyag brgya bkrol nas/ bdag bskyed kyi lha gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'i rnam pa lam byed mngon byang lnga sogs sgom pa dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs mdo dang thun mong ma yin pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par mang du gsungs/ 'di'i rang lam gyi tshe lo brgya pa'i mi'i skye ba bcu drug gi yun tshod tsam la/ dbang po rno shos kyis phyag rgya chen po 'grub par bshad/ de'i yun tshad nyis 'gyur gyis sa bcu pa la sbyor ba yin no/ /spyod rgyud dang rnal 'byor rgyud 'di gnyis la/ las tshogs kyi skabs 'ga' re ma gtogs/ dka' spyad dang khrus sogs kyi gtsang sbra mi dgos/ gtsang rme med pa'i spyod pa yang mi byed do//de ltar rgyud sde de gsum gyi lam gyis sa bcu pa thob pa yang*/

bla med la zhugs nas sangs rgyas la sbyor ba yin/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud ni/ dbang gi dus na/ bum dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ sher dbang*/ dbang bzhi pa ste/ dbang bzhi rdzogs pa dang*/ lam bskyed rim ma dag pa'i snang ba dbyings su sbyangs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rdzogs par sgom/ dbang dang bskyed rim gnyis ka la/ yar sangs rgyas dang rnam pa mthun pa'i lam du byed tshul gcig dang*/ mar 'khor ba dang rnam pa mthun pa'i dri ma sbyong tshul gcig ste/ sbyang gzhi/ sbyang bya/ sbyong byed/ sbyangs 'bras zhib mor sbyor/ thun mtshams su snang ba thams cad lhar sgom/ bdag bskyed kyi lha mi gshegs/ rdzogs rim rdo rje'i lus rtsa rlung thig le la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs ston/ spros bcas spros med/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa gsum spyad pas/ 'bras bu la sbyor bar bzhed/ skye ba snga mar bsags rgyab can ma yin kyang*/ bsam pa'i stobs che ba gcig gis 'bad pas bsgoms na/ tshe lo brgya pa'i mi'i tshe gang gcig gi yun la/ lam gzhan la ma ltos par sangs rgyas kyi sa thob nus te/ dbang po rno zhing bar chad med pa'i dbang du byas pa yin no/ /lam de rnams ston byed kyi sde snod so so gtso che ba bod du 'gyur ba'i rags rim tsam ngos bzung na/ so so thar ba'i mdo/ 'dul ba'i lung sde bzhi/ gdags pa'i bstan bcos/ mdo sde las brgya pa/ rten 'brel gyi mdo/ chos 'khor gyi mdo/ don rnam par nges pa'i mdo la sogs pa 'khor lo dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gyi mdo/ che chung sdom pa lnga cu tsam yod de/ nyan thos la gsungs pa theg dman gyi sde snod do/ /'bum nyi khri brgyad stong pa sogs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo rnams ni 'khor lo bar pa'i mdo yin cing*/ grangs bcu bdun tsam yod/ snying po'i mdo sde zab mo phyir mi zlog pa 'khor lo'i gtam ston byed nyi shu tsam yod pa ni/

'khor lo tha ma'i mdo'i gtso bo yin la/ gzhan dkon mchog brtsegs pa dang*/ 'dus pa chen po dang*/ sdong po bkod pa dang*/ phal po che shas che ba zhig dang*/ bskal bzang dang*/ ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal sogs mdo sde phal che ba yang*/ tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor gyi mdo yin te/ 'khor lo bar mtha' gnyis bsdoms pa la theg chen gyi mdo zhes grags shing*/ yongs dril mdo rnam dag sum brgya nye ba bzhugs/ bya rgyud la rigs drug yod pa las/ dam tshig gsum bkod dang*/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud sogs de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ don yod zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo dang*/ zhal bcu gcig pa'i gzungs sogs pad+ma'i rigs/ phyag rdor rig pa mchog gi rgyud sogs rdo rje'i rigs/ nor rgyun ma dang*/ dzam+bha la'i gzungs sogs nor bu'i rigs/ me kha le'i gzungs sogs lnga rtsen gyi rigs/ lha klu 'byung po phal pas phul ba'i gzungs mang po rnams 'jig rten phal pa'i rigs so/ /spyod rgyud la rigs gsum las/ sku'i rigs ni/ rnam snang mngon byang dang*/ mi g.yo ba brtul phod sogs yin/ gsung gi rigs bod du ma 'gyur/ thugs kyi rigs phyag rdor dbang bskur ba'i rgyud sogs so/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la/ pha rgyud de nyid bsdus pa dang*/ rdo rje rtse mo sogs/ ma rgyud dpal mchog dang po dang*/ rdo rje snying rgyan sogs so/ /bla med la pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis/ pha rgyud la gsum las/ chags can rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyud ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa dang*/ gshin rje gshed dmar nag dang*/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba la sogs pa dang*/ zhe sdang can tshar gcod kyi rgyud ni/ 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa bdun pa lta bu dang*/ gti mug can rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyud ni/ 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba yin pa las/ phyogs 'dir ni mtshan brjod tsam zhig 'gyur ro/ /ma rgyud la rigs drug las/ bde mchogadagyes rdor/

mahā mā ya/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ rdo rje a ral+li/ ṛ ṣi a ral+li/ phyag chen thig le sogs he ru ka'i rigs/ gdan bzhi rnam snang gi rigs/ rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po pad+ma'i rigs/ rdo rje bdud rtsi rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rigs/ sgrol ma bla med sogs rta'i rgyal po'i rigs/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dang*/ zla gsang thig le rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs yin la/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo yang*/ he ru ka dang rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs gnyis ka la brten pa ltar yod kyang*/ rdo rje sems pa'i rigs nyid yin no/ /ci ste rnal 'byor bla med la rigs gsum du nges par 'byed na ni/ gnyis med rgyud kyi ngos 'dzin dus 'khor kho na la byed dgos te/ thabs shes rab kyi phan tshun rgyas gdab mang po dus 'khor nas gsungs la/ dus 'khor la ltos na brgyud sde gzhan rnams rgyas gdab ste bsdus pas so/ /'on kyang*/ bla med kyi rgyud la thabs rgyud dang*/ shes rab kyi rgyud dang*/ gnyis med kyi rgyud gsum du 'byed pa ni/ bod kyis brtags pa'i rnam rtog tsam mo/ /pha ma gnyis kyi khyad par ni lha yab kyi dkyil 'khor dang sngags dang cho ga kho na rtsal du 'don pa ni/ thabs kyi rgyud yin la/ lha yum gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ sngags dang cho ga kho na rtsal du 'don pa'am/ yab yum gnyis kar gyi dkyil 'khor dang sngags dang phyag rgya cha mnyam par rtsal du 'don pa ni rnal 'byor ma'i brgyud yin te/ bde dgyes dus 'khor sogs ma rgyud gtso che ba phal cher las cha mnyam du ston la/ gdan bzhi sogs 'ga' zhig las yum kho na rtsal du 'don no/ /de ltar na dngos bstan tshig zin gyi dbang du byas na/ bla med kyi rgyud rnams la yang zab mi zab kyi khyad yod la/ pha rgyud nas bshad pa'i zab don rnams/ ma rgyud la yang yod cing*/ pha rgyud nas ma bshad pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos 'ga' re yang*/

ma rgyud la snang bas/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud nyid mchog tu bya'o/ /'on kyang mtha' drug dang tshul bzhi'i sgo nas rnam par phye ba dang*/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gis bkral na ni/ bla med kyi rgyud thams cad dgongs pa gcig tu 'gyur ba'i phyir/ mchog dman gyi dbye ba thub par dka' 'o/ /de dag las skabs 'dir/ rgyud thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo ni/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i phyi lo nag pa'i nya la/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten chen por/ dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor chen po mngon par sprul/ 'khor sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa dang*/ lha chen bcu gnyis sogs/ lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po'i tshogs dang*/ chu bo sī ta'i byang phyogs grong bye ba phrag dgu cu rtsa drug gi mi'i 'gro ba skal ldan dpag tu med pa 'dus pa'i dbus su/ phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa'i sku rgyal po zla ba bzang pos zhus pa'i ngor gsungs pa yin la/ der rgyud 'dir ma zad/ rgyud mtha' dag gsungs nas/ phyag na rdo rje la gtad pa yin cing*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa bgrang ba las 'das pa 'dod pa'i dngos grub thob par gyur/ re shig mi'i 'jig rten gzhan du ma dar/ sham+bha lar rgyal po zla ba bzang pos rgyud mtha' dag glegs bam la bris/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa rgyud mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas stong phrag bcu gnyis pa la/ 'grel bshad stong phrag drug cu pa mdzad/ rgyu rin po che sna tshogs pa las/ lha'i bzo ba'i 'du byed kyis dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa khru bzhi brgya pa bzhengs/ skye bo'i tshogs la sngags kyi theg pa rgya cher gsungs/ mang po zhig dngos grub mchog la bkod/ rtsa rgyud gsungs pa'i dus nas lo gnyis pa la/ sa'i snying po'i sprul pa sras lha'i dbang po rgyal srid du bskos nas chos kyi dbyings su gshegs so/

/de rjes sa bcu'i dbang phyug so so'i sprul pa'i sku/ lha dbang dang*/ gzi brjid can dang*/ zla bas byin dang*/ lha'i dbang phyug dang*/ sna tshogs gzugs dang*/ lha'i dbang ldan te/ de dag gis kyang zla ba bzang po bzhin du dar ba mdzad do/ /de rjes 'jam dpal gyi sprul ba rgyal po grags pas lo brgya'i bar du sngon bzhin chos bstan nas/ slar yang rtsa rgyud las lung bstan pa ltar/ yul chen po dgu bcu rtsa drug na gnas pa'i/ tshangs pa'i rigs kyi drang srong bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi rnams skal ba mchog dang ldan zhing*/ 'dul ba'i dus la bab par yang gzigs/ de dag ma btul na ma 'ongs pa na de dag gi bu brgyud las kla klo'i chos 'byung ba yang mkhyen/ de rnams sngags kyi bstan la bcug na/ yul dgu bcu rtsa drug gi mi rnams sngags kyi lam la 'jug par yang mkhyen/ drang srong rnams kyang dang por 'jam po kho nas mi thul te/ bsdigs shing bskrad na thul bar mkhyen nas/ drang srong rnams kyi mchog nyi ma'i shing rta la bka' bsgos te/ drang srong rnams kyi spyod pa tha dad pa rnams dris shing*/ de rnams kyis kyang zhus pa na/ khyed rnams rang rang gi lta ba mu stegs kyi grub mtha' tha dad pa rnams dang*/ spyod pa sna tshogs pa rnams dor te/ rdo rje'i theg pa la rigs gcig tu gyis shig par bka' stsal ba na/ de rnams rang rang gi lta spyod ngan pa la mngon par zhen pas/ rdo rje'i rigs la mi 'jug ste/ de bas rang yul bor nas/ 'phags pa'i yul du 'gro bar spro ba'i tshe/ rgyal po'i bka' drag pos lho phyogs su bskrad/ zhag bcu'i bar du song ste/ bcu pa la nags tshal chen po zhugs pa'i tshe/ gnyid 'thug pos non par byin gyis brlabs/ mi ma yin rnams la bka' bsgos te/ gnyid ma sad pa kho nar/ skad cig la nam mkha'i ngos nas khyer 'ongs te/ mā la ya'i skyed tshal gyi dbus/ rgyal po zla ba bzang pos bzhengs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa'i drung du phyin par gyur pa na gnyid sad do/

/de nas ya mtshan du gyur pa na/ blon po rgya mtsho'i blo gros kyis brda' sbyar te/ nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs pa drang srong rnams kyis gsol ba btab par gyur pa'i tshe/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing*/ rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi snying po bsdus pa dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi rgyal pos bsdus rgyud du grags pa 'di gsungs te/ gzhung gi tshad ni rtsa rgyud las bsdus pa'i tshig ni/ 'phreng 'dzin gyi sde sbyor can gyi sh+lau ka stong dang sum cu yin la/ rtsa rgyud rjes sngags kyi sdeb sbyor yin par 'dod pas/ rjes sngags tshad kyis gzhal na rags rtsis la sum stong gi tshad tsam du 'gyur bas/ rtsa rgyud kyi bzhi cha tsam mo/ /der nag pa'i nya la drang srong rnams la dbang bskur zhing rgyud bshad pas/ de'i zla ba phyi ma sa ga'i nya la drang srong de rnams thams cad kyis gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku grub bo/ /de'i rjes su spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa pad+ma dkar pos/ bsdus pa'i rgyud la 'grel bshad dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba stong phrag bcu gnyis pa mdzad do/ /de la drang srong rigs pa tha dad pa rnams rdo rje theg pa la rigs gcig tu mdzad pas/ rgyal po grags pa'i sku tshe'i tha mar rigs ldan gyi mtshan gsol zhing*/ de man chad du/ rigs gcig pa'i rgyud la gnas pas/ rigs ldan zhes bya ste/ pad+ma dkar po'i rjes su sa bcu'i dbang phyug so so'i sprul pa'i sku/ bzang po dang*/ rnam rgyal dang*/ bshes gnyen bzang po dang*/ phyag dmar dang*/ khyab 'jug sbas pa dang*/ nyi ma grags dang*/ shin tu bzang po dang*/ rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang*/ rgyal dka' dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ sna tshogs gzugs dang*/ zla 'od dang*/ mtha' yas dang*/ sa skyong dang*/ dpal skyong dang*/ seng ge dang*/ rnam par gnon pa dang*/ stobs po che dang*/ ma 'gags pa dang*/ mi'i seng ge dang*/ dbang phyug chen po dang*/ mtha' yas rnam rgyal dang*/

'khor lo can te/ grags pa nas 'di'i bar la nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /de dag las khyab 'jug sbas pas/ rdzu 'phrul gyis kha che'i yul du byon zhing*/ rdo ring btsugs/ zla ba gsum du sngags kyi theg pa mang du gsungs/ chos ston pa'i tshe sa g.yo zhing 'od 'byin pa dang*/ kha che'i mtsho nang klu'i pho brang du yang yang 'byon zhing*/ klu rnams dngos su chos nyan pa sogs cho 'phrul mang po bstan/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs dang*/ ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs sogs mdzad de/ nam mkha'i lam las phyir gshegs so zhes grag go /dus 'di tsam na/ slob dpon chen po dpal phyogs glang ngam/ chos kyi grags pas bstan pa skyong ba'i dus tsam yin par mngon no/ /rigs ldan rgyal dka'i dus su/ 'phags pa'i yul du dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ da lta dpal skyong seng ge'i khri la bzhugs zhes bya zhing*/ chos rgyal lha dbang nas brtsams te mtha' yas rnam rgyal gyi bar du thams cad kyang rgyal srid la lo grangs rgya phrag re re bzhugs par mnyam mo/ /drag pos kyang lo brgya'i bar du sngar bzhin chos bstan nas/ kla klo'i 'dul bar bzhed pa ltar re zhig khas blang bar bya la/ nyi ma grags seng ge'i khri la 'khod pa tsam na/ mkha'i yul du kla klo'i chos lhag par dar zhing*/ 'phags yul gyi nub kyis rnams su gsar du dar la/ kla klo'i ston pa sbrang rtsi'i blo gros kyi dus de yin par mngon no/ /de nas da lta'i bar du cher 'phel zhing*/ ma 'ongs pa na/ chu bo shī ta'i lho phyogs thams cad kla klor gyur pa'i tshe/ kla klo rnams 'dul ba'i dus la bab pa na/ 'khor lo can gyi sprul pa'i dmag tshogs kyis kla klo thams cad bcom ste/ kla klo sprul pa rnams ni bsad ba'i tshul bstan/ rang rgyud pa rnams kyi dregs pa zhi bar mdzad de/ yang dag pa'i lam la bkod nas/ mthar sprul pa bsdu bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas dus rnams kyang rdzogs ldan du 'gyur zhing*/

'khor lo can gyi sras tshangs pa dang*/ lha dbang gnyis/ lha dbang gi rgyud la 'od srungs sogs shin tu mang po dag 'byung ste/ sa dum bu bcu gnyis rnams su 'khor zhing*/ lo ny-i khri chig stong drug brgya'i bar du chos min kla klo'i chos nyams shing*/ yang dag pa'i lam dar bar mdzad do/ /'di tsam zhig yongs su grags pa ltar bkod pa yin la/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rnam par thar ba gsang ba ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin pa'i phyir/ rig dras kyi pho tshod don la gnas pa dka' 'o/ /de nas rgya bod du dar lugs la/ rgya gar du lugs mang po dang 'brel ba'i gtam brgyud yod cing*/ bod du yang*/ gyi co lo tsā ba zla ba'i 'od zer/ rma dge ba'i blo gros/ 'a zha rgya gar brtsegs/ khyung po chos brtson/ rwa chos rab/ rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags sogs kyi lugs shin tu mang yang*/ mchog tu gyur pa 'bro lugs sam/ zla mgon lugs ltar bshad na/ 'phags pa'i yul du gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa zhig gi sras/ dus 'khor zhabs chen por grags pa de ni/ mtshan dngos mañdzu badz+ra/ mdo sngags thams cad la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ rten dge bsnyen/ 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzigs pa zhig yin la/ yi dam gyi lung bstan nas byang phyogs su gshegs pas/ lam du rigs ldan gyi sprul pa dang mjal/ dbang bskur zhing zab mo'i rnal 'byor zla ba drug bsgoms pas rdzu 'phrul thob ste byang sham+bha lar byon/ rigs ldan dngos dang mjal/ dus kyi 'khor lo sogs rgyud sde mang po dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel ba skor gsum sogs/ 'ga' zhig thugs la gzung*/ 'ga' zhig glegs bam spyan drangs te 'phags yul du byon/ phal cher sgom pa gtso bor mdzad/ mu stegs kyi dpungs lta stangs kyis gnon pa sogs rdzu 'phrul mang du bstan/ mthar 'ja' lus su gshegs/ 'di la slob ma bcu gnyis tsam byung na'ang*/ thams cad rnal 'byor pa sha stag tu gyur cing*/

grub pa'i rtags dang cho 'phrul mang du bsten nas/ 'ja' lus su gshegs pas/ bshad rgyun la phan pa tsam ma byung*/ dus zhabs pa chung pa kho nas chos 'di dar bar mdzad de/ mtshan dngos ni shrī bha dra/ rigs ni rje rigs/ rten dge bsnyen/ theg pa mtha' dag la shin tu mkhas pa/ mngon shes thogs med du mnga'/ chu la mi 'bying*/ rtsig pa dang ri la thogs med du gzhud/ 'dis dpal nā lan+dar paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya dang 'bel gtam byas pas/ de thams cad smra bas zil gyis mnan/ ngag dbang grags pa dang*/ shes rab 'byung gnas ma gtogs thams cad kyis zhabs la gtugs/ chos 'dis sa steng thams cad khyab par mdzad de/ rgyal po dang*/ blon po dang*/ tshong dpon chen po rnams kyis kyang*/ glegs bam bzheng ba dang*/ bag chags 'jog pa byung*/ rgya gar du dus 'khor ma phebs gong phar bzhagade phyin chad dus 'khor gyi grub thob phyogs gcig tu gzhagachos gzhan gyi grub thob thams cad phyogs gcig tu gzhag kyang*/ dus 'khor gyi grub thob mang ngo*/ /dus zhabs pa chung ba de nyid kyi sras nā len+d+ra pa ni/ mtshan dngos bo dhi bha dra/ nā len+d+ra zhes bya ba'i gnas gzhi'i bdag po mdzad/ las bzhi gang sgrub kyang rlung gi rnal 'byor kho nas 'grub bo/ /de la slob ma mang yang phyogs 'dir phrin las che ba kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba mgon po ni/ dbugs theng re la sh+lau ka bcu drug tsam re zin pa'i shes rab mnga'/ bla ma bram ze bzang po'i zhabs zhes bya ba cig bsten/ kha che'i yul gyi chos thams cad mkhyen/ slar yul dbus su byon nas nā len+d+ra pa la dus 'khor sogs sngags kyi zab don dpag tu med pa gsan/ bsgoms pas srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa mthar phyin/ sku la bshang gci'i rgyu ba chad/ chom rkun la sdigs mdzub mdzad pas rengs pa sogs nus pa mnga'/ bod du lan gsum byon/ sgron gsal dang*/ rig tshogs dang*/ sa sde sogs chos mang du gsungs/ khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo shin tu dar bar mdzad/

man ngag la bka' dog ste/ phal cher la sor spong tsam las ma gnang*/ gdams ngag yongs rdzogs gnang pa gsum yod kyang*/ lo ro ba yin pa cig ni/ grum bus zin nas sgom long ma byung bar 'das/ pu rangs ba'i dge slong gcig gis yer par bsgoms pas 'ja' lus su song*/ chos kyi brgyud pa la phan pa lha rje sgom pa yin/ de la 'bro lo tsā ba shes rab grags kyi rgyud 'grel gzhung 'grel mang po dang bcas pa bsgyur paṇ+ḍi ta'i lo tsā ba mdzad/ lha rje sgom pa'i yang bla ma yin pas shin tu sku drin che/ 'di 'khrungs yul la stod lho'i gnyan rtse ba yin/ paṇa chen zla mgon rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog tu 'khur/ gzhan paṇa grub kyi bla ma mang*/ sku tshe'i smad la kha che nyid du bzhugs/ bla ma lha rje sgom pas/ paṇa chen zla mgon la dbang rgyud bshad man ngag mtha' dag rdzogs par gsan/ bla ma sgro ston gyis paṇa chen la dbang dang rgyud bshad rdzogs par thob/ grub chen yu mos chos 'brel tsam gsan/ de la lha rje sgom pa ni/ 'khrungs yul 'phan yul grab/ mtshan dkon mchog bsrungs/ rten dge bsnyen/ sngags pa tshangs spyod/ sman dpyad dang*/ mngon pa dang*/ sngags rnying ma gsum la mkhas pa gcig yin pa/ yo byad thams cad dril bas gser srang drug dang*/ dar yug gcig byung ba paṇa chen la phul/ sgyu lus kyi zhabs tog byed par zhus nas/ gdams ngag zhus te bsgoms pas/ nyams rtogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'khrungs/ bran ka dang*/ 'o de gung rgyal sogs dam la brtags/ bram pa skam po las chu bton/ gzhan sems shes pa sogs yon tan dpag tu med do/ /bla ma sgro ston ni/ rus sgro/ 'khrungs yul 'phan yul spras pa/ bzhugs sa snor bzang*/ rten sngags pa dkar po/ mtshan gnam la brtsegs/ chos mngon pa/ sa sde/ dbu ma rig tshogs/ gsang 'dus sgron gsal/ yo ga sman dpyad sogs la mkhas pa zhig yin/ paṇa chen zla mgon la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang zhus/

rgyud bshad mkhas par nyan/ sbyor drug gi man ngag rnams lha rje sgom pa la zhus/ phyis paṇa chen nyid la yang bka'i gnang ba thob/ nyams rtogs mthar phyin pa brnyes te/ yi dam gyi lha mang po zhal gzigs/ mngon shes thogs med mnga'/ bzhed don thams cad mkha' 'gro la bka' bsgos pa tsam gyi 'grub bo/ /grub chen yu mo ni/ gdung rus rngam/ 'khrungs yul gangs ti se'i 'gram/ phyis rab tu byung ba'i mtshan dad pa rgyal po/ gsang mtshan mi bskyod rdo rje zhes bya/ dbus gtsang du bla ma mang du bsten/ sog 'dul 'dzin tshul khrims bla ma'i thugs zin gyi slob mar gyur/ phyis gsang sngags la mos nas sngags chos mang du gsan/ rdo rje snying 'grel gyi mtshan gsan pas kyang dga' ba dpag tu med pa skyes/ bla ma sgro ston lo tsā'i bar du bsten nas/ khod la bzhugs pa'i dbang rgyud man ngag mtha' dag thob/ bdag po'i dbang dang*/ bdag po chen po'i dbang rgyud 'grel las ji skad gsungs pa bla ma'i kyang gnang*/ phyis 'u yug gi rgya la gnas su bzhugs/ bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad/ sngags kyi gzhan stong grub mtha'i srol ka phye/ mngon shes thogs pa med pa mnga'/ skya ka dang bya rog tu sprul pa sogs/ yul sna tshogs su sprul sgyur mang du mdzad pa'i lo rgyus yod/ grub thob gyi snyan grags kyang shin tu che bas sa steng khyab bo/ /de nyid kyi sras dharme shwa ra chos kyi dbang phyug yin te/ mkhyen rab shin tu che/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa la yang*/ dbang mdor bstan gyi rgyud la thugs bshad mdzad/ bcu drug pa la rgyud 'grel chen mo thugs nas gsungs/ grub chen la mnga' ba'i gzhung gdams ngag thams cad dgung lo nyi shu tshun la thugs su chud/ mkhas pa mang du bsten pas/ mdo sngags kyi chos la mi mkhyen bya ba med/ khyad par dbu tshad gnyis dang*/ gsang 'dus dus 'khor rnams la rtsal du thon/ sa chen kun dga' snying po dang*/ dpyal lo kun dga' rdo rje dang*/

rngog zhe sdang rdo rje sogs kyang 'bel gtam gyis zil gyis mnan/ thog mnyam gyi jo sras gcig la 'di las mkhas pa med/ 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa yang grags skad/ de'i bu chen mkhas pa nam mkha' 'od zer ni/ 'khrungs yul dang bzhugs sa khang gsar yin/ rten dge bsnyen dkar po/ chos dbu tshad/ phar phyin/ mngon pa/ sa sde/ sems 'grel skor gsum/ gsang 'dus 'phags skor sogs la mkhas/ rdo rje phag mo dang*/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i zhal gzigs/ 'od zer 'phreng ba sogs bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad do/ /sras mchog chos kyi dbang phyug la sras lcam sring gsum byon pa las/ 'gro don can gnyis te/ lcam lha rje jo 'bum ni/ in+d+ra bo dhi'i lcam lak+ṣaṃ ka ra'i sprul pa'i sku yin par grags shing*/ mkhyen pa che bas dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel yongs rdzogs thugs la bzhugs/ gzhon nu'i dus na spyod pa nges med cig yod pa/ dar bab kyi dus na yum gyis bskul te/ gshin rje gshed phyag rgya zil gnon sgrub pas zhal gzigs/ tshe bdag dang lha chen dpal 'bar phran du 'khol/ srog mthu/ cho 'phrul ser ba sogs zhag dus theb pa kho na byung ste/ drag sngags kyi mthu shin tu che/ dgung lo sum cu so drug pa la snyung gzhi drag po byung bas thugs bskul te/ gnas lugs ma rtogs na cis kyang dgos pa med pa mkhyen/ yab la gsan pa'i sbyor ba yan lag drug bsgoms pas/ zhag gcig la rtags bcu rdzogs/ bdun la rlung dbu mar thim/ grub thob chen mor gyur te/ dben par zla phyed tsam/ zla re tsam mi zas ye ma gsol kyang*/ nyam stobs ches bzang ba dang*/ srin po ri'i brag gi skyibs mis mi thar ba rnams su 'gro 'ong mdzad cing sgom/ nad yam la bden stobs brjod pa tsam gyis chad pa dang*/ nad pa la phyag gi reg pa tsam gyis nad las grol ba sogs rtags mngon gyur mnga'o/ /de nyid kyi ming por gyur pa/ grub thob se mo che ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan yin te/

dang po spyan rab rib/ snyan mi bsang*/ ljags kyang mi bde ba zhig byung bas/ re chen po med kyang sbyor ba yan lag drug pa bsgoms pas nyams rtogs dang mkhyen rab nang nas rdol te/ mkhas pa nam mkha' 'od zer gyi drung du/ dus 'khor gyi rgyud 'grel la sbyangs pas mkhas par mkhyen/ sprul sku jo 'bum la dbang mdor bstan dang bka' 'grel pad+ma can gsan/ bla ma gzhan la/ bde mchog/kyai rdor/ nā ro chos drug sogs kyang gsan/ lcam jo 'bum sku 'das nas/ phyis lo mchod kyi dus su zhag bco lnga ting nge 'dzin thun gcig la song*/ de rjes sngon gyi skye ba thams cad dran/ phyis skye ba re la sa re dgrod nas/ skye ba bcu bzhi nas sangs rgya ba'i gnas tshul thams cad gzigs/ des mtshon te/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi skye ba snga phyi dang tshe 'di'i bde sdug thams cad sgrib med du mkhyen/ ma sbas pa mang du yang gsungs/ gtsang po la ji ltar gshegs cha med par chu pha khar zang gi gshegs pa mang du byung*/ grub thob kyi mtshan grags shin tu che/ rten dge slong yin/ sku tshe'i smad la gtsang 'o lung se mo che'i dgon pa btab ste/ der shas cher bzhugs/ chos rje 'jam dbyangs gsar ma ni/ mtshan shes rab 'od zer/ 'khrungs yul nyang stod/ sngags rnying ma ba'i rgyud du 'khrungs/ gzhon nu nas rab tu byung ste/ 'u mtshan nyid kyi grwa mang por byon/ khyad par gsang phur gnyal zhig gi slob ma'i gtso bor gyur/ bar skabs su bsnyung mdze byung*/ lo phyed dang gnyis phyag na rdo rje'i sgom bzlas mdzad pas snyung ba gdangs/ mi gzhan gdon gyi z-in pa la sngags btab pa tsam gyis phan pa byung*/ 'jam dbyangs zhal gzigs pa la lung bstan zhus pas/ grub thob se mo che pa dang las 'brel yod par lung bstan te/ 'u yug la mjal du phebs pa'i lam du/ lha 'dre cho 'phrul mi bzad pa byung yang mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang du bzhagase mo che ba la dus 'khor gyi dbang gsan pa'i tshe/

bla ma dus 'khor dngos su gzigs/ bsgoms pas nyams rtogs mthar phyir/ rkyang 'dur gyi 'chad nyan kyang mdzad de/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa mdzad na 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes rgyu yin pas/ de ltar bzhed pa la slob ma rnams kyis bshol btab ste ma thon pas/ bshad sgrub spel ma'i ngang la bzhugs so/ /grub thob se mo che ba yan chad/ dus 'khor la shin tu bka' dog gnyan cha che ba yin/ chos rje 'jam gsar nas gzung cung zad bka' yangs su song*/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer ni/ gser sdings pa gzhon nu 'od kyi sras yin/ mtshan dngos chos kyi 'od zer yin pa la/ bla chen 'phags pa rin po ches/ khyed chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin du 'dug pas/ chos sku 'od zer du thogs gsung*/ mdo sngags thams cad la shin tu mkhyen pa che/ khyad par gsang 'dus 'phags skor dang*/ kyai rdor dpyal rngog gnyis 'dus la mkhas pa/ gsang 'dus rim lnga'i nyams rtogs kyang tshad du phyin pa zhiga'ajam dbyangs gsar ma la dus 'khor gyi dbang rgyud man ngag thams cad rdzogs par gsan pas/ nyams rtogs brgya 'gyur du 'phel/ dbang gi ye shes dbab pa'i skabs bla ma rdo rje shugs su gzigs/ ye shes phebs nas nyi ma phyed tsam phebs pa ma btang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud yongs su rdzogs pa rgya skad du sangs kyis bton/ bla ma gsung nas/ 'di kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī'i skye ba yin te/ de'i tshe gsang 'dus la mkhas par sbyangs pa'i bag chags yin gsung*/ mnal thams cad 'od gsal du chug nas/ gzigs rtog dang*/ chos gsan pa dang*/ sgom bzlas thams cad mnal gyi ngang nas grub par mdzad/ sgrub khang du 'dag sbyang la bzhugs pa dang*/ 'bum pa la bskor ba mdzad pa dus gcig tu 'byung ba sogs/ sku lus kyi bkod pa yang mang du bstan to/ /chos rje kun spangs chen po zhang thugs rje brtson 'grus ni/ mdog gi dab phyar du sku 'khrungs/ sa skya dang mdar sogs dbus gtsang gi grwa sa phal cher du phebs/

mdo sngags thams cad la mkhyen pa shin tu rgyas/ chu mig pa seng ge dpal sogs mkhas mchog thams cad zil gyis mnan/ mdar dang don mo rir zur chos kyang mdzad/ de nas 'jam gsar gyi gdan sa rkyang 'dur gyi chos dpon mdzad cing*/ kun mkhyen chos sku ba la mnga' ba'i gzhung gdams ngag thams cad gsan/ khyad par dus 'khor ra lugs sngar nas mkhyen cing*/ kun mkhyen chos sku ba la 'bro lugs kyi dbang rgyud bshad dang*/ sbyor drug nyams khrid du gsan pas/ nyams rtogs kyi klaung brdol/ spyi sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i gdams pa mi 'dra ba bcu bdun tsam gsan cing nyams su myong bar mdzad/ srog rtsol bsgoms pas/ 'byung ba lnga'i rlung stobs su gyur te/ thugs nyams 'ur langs/ phyag ya re mi bcu bcus mi thub dang*/ gzims khang na yod pa rnams res 'ga' 'khyags te mi tshugs pa dang*/ res 'ga' tshad pas gdungs te mi tshugs pa dang*/ gzims khang yom yom du g.yo ba dang*/ bug sgo rtsig pa la thogs med du gshegs pa rnams byung*/ lan gcig srog gegs cung zad byung ba/ kun mkhyen chos sku bas mngon shes kyis mkhyen nas phebs te bsal/ der nyams rtogs mthar phyin nas/ spyan ras gzigs zhal bcu gcig pa sogs yi dam dpag tu med pa'i zhal gzigs/ de nas 'chad nyan bor te kun spangs mdzad/ ri khrod nges med la thegs/ lha sa'i jo bo bcu gcig zhal la sogs gsol ba yun ring du btab pas/ spyan ras gzigs smar khrid kyi bka' rgya grol ba'i lung bstan byung*/ se mkhar chung du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi snying po bsdu bar dgongs nas gsol ba btab pas/ chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams dus gcig tu zhal gzigs nas bkas gnang*/ 'di la dge mtshan lan gsum byung*/ de dus nags sman rgyal mos spyan 'dren byung yang*/ cung zad dus la ma bab par mkhyen te/ lo gsum nas 'byor par zhal gyis bzhes/ phyis phebs nas mkha' spyod bde ldan du rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i man ngag snyan brgyud du bzhugs pa rnams yi ger 'god pa mdzad pa na/

dus kyi 'khor lo nyid zhal gzigs nas lung bstan thob/ 'di sbyor drug gi 'khrid yig rgyas pa bod du byung ba'i snga shos yin/ phyis skyid phug bde ldan du phebs/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa zhal gzigs/ lam 'bras la 'khrugs sdebs kyi yig cha mdzad/ gsang sngags gsar rnying sgo mtha' dag nas chos kyi sgo spel/ phyogs rigs med pa nas 'dus pa'i sgom chen drug brgya re rtag tu 'tshogs/ nyams rtogs bzang po ma skyes pa gcig kyang med/ sbyor drug la nyams len gyi mthil du mdzad/ rgyud 'grel chen mo yang mang du gsungs/ rgyud snying lo re bzhin lan gnyis gnyis gsungs/ byams sems chen po gdan sar bskos nas/ zhing 'di na gdul bya med pas gzhan du 'gro zhes sku 'da' bar dgongs pa na/ byang sems chen po bsnyung bas/ zla ba shas shig sku tshe bsrings/ yang gshegs par bzhed pa la slob ma rnams kyis gsol ba btab pas zla ba phyed bzhugs/ de nas bsnyung bar med par sku 'das/ byang sems chen po rgyal ba ye shes ni/ 'khrungs yul mdo khams/ chung ngu'i dus su karma pag shi'i grwa pa yin/ rje pag shi de sku 'khor pa thams cad la bka' drag tu skyon pa zhig yod pas/ shin tu 'jigs pa zhig yod pa la/ shing khur zhig bsnams nas byon pas/ nags bseb gcig tu bla ma sku rkyang byon pa dang thug gis mjal/ skrag ste bros pas/ bla ma na re/ de tshugs ma byed/ da lta bla ma la bros na bar dor yang 'bros/ tshur shog gsung*/ de nas 'jigs pa sangs/ lo mang du bsten/ khong la mnga' ba'i gdams ngag thams cad gsan cing bsgoms/ 'on kyang de skabs nyams myong rtsal che ba tsam ma byung*/ de nas bla ma pa'i zhal nas/ ri khrod nges med 'grims/ chos la phyogs ris ma byed/ bla ma bzang po gcig dang mjal bar 'dug gi gsungs pas de bzhin du mdzad/ shar ba 'jam dbyangs chen po'i sku gzhogs su yun ring du bzhugs/ mdo sngags kyi chos mang du gsan/

chos rje kun spangs chen po dang mjal nas shin tu dad pa thob/ rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa gsan pas nyams rtogs mthar phyin/ gzhung gdams ngag thams cad bum pa gang byor gnang*/ gnas nges med du gshegs par bzhed pa la/ 'jam dbyangs chen po'i bka' ma chogs te/ bde chen gyi dgon pa btab/ sgrub pa'i ngang nas chos kyang mang du gsungs/ thugs snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin du bzhugs pas/ byang sems chen po'i mtshan thogs/ kun spangs chen po'i bka' gnang ba la rten/ jo nang gi gdan sar phebs/ dgon gnyis kar du sgrub grwa rgya cher bskyangs/ zhabs la gtugs tshad gnas lugs kyi rang zhal lta shes pa kho na byung*/ mthar phug mo chos rjong gi ri khrod du sku gshegs/ mkhas btsun chen po yon tan rgya mtsho ni/ byang sems chen po de nyid kyi mched grogs dang*/ slob ma dang*/ rgyal tshab gsum ka yin/ mdog gi mkhar rnying du sngags rnying ma ba'i rgyud du 'khrungs/ grwa sa mang du bsten pa las/ gtso bor mdar du sbyangs pa mdzad/ gsang sngags phyogs kyi bla ma mang du bsten/ khyad par shar pa 'jam dbyangs chen po'i bu chen dang zur chos pa'i gtso bo yin/ khong pa'i bka' nan gyis thugs blos mi longs bzhin du/ rgya nag du yang phebs dgos byung*/ chos rje yab sras gnyis dang sngar nas dpon slob du gyur pa yin cing*/ de skabs jo nang du phebs/ kun spangs chen po la zab lam gyi 'khrid gsan/ mtshan ma'i rnal 'byor zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig la rtags bcu rdzogs par mthar phyin/ nyin mo'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs/ 'phar g.yo'i nyams cher byung ste/ mda' rgyang tsam dang rdo rgyang tsam du 'phar ba'i 'phar g.yos jo nang gi ri klungs med par byon pa zhag bdun gyi bar du byung*/ de sangs nas mnyam nyid chen po gcig gi ngang du gyur/ mngon mkhyen thogs pa med par mnga'/ chos la 'di ma gsan dang 'di mi mkhyen med pa tsam yin/ sku btsun pa rab kyi mthar thug pas/

tshul khrims kyi dri bsrung rgya cher 'phro ba zhig ste/ dang por kun spangs chos rje bla ma bsten tshul rgyud nas bshad pa ltar bsten/ de rjes byang sems chen po gdan sar phebs pa la'ang*/ kun spangs chen po dang khyad med du bsten/ byang sems chen po sku 'das nas jo nang gi gdan sar phebs/ sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa rgya cher bskyangs te/ lo bdun lhag tsam nas kun mkhyen chen po gdan sar bskyos/ de rjes lo gnyis tsam nas sku 'das so/ /chos rje kun mkhyen chen po dus gsum sangs rgyas ni/ 'khrungs yul dol po pan tshang ba/ rus sngags rnying ma yin/ yul du bla ma skyi stengs pa sogs bla ma mang rab bsten/ chos kyang rnying ma dang*/ dbu ma rig tshogs sogs dang*/ rig gnas dang bzo gnas phra mo mang po chung ngu'i dus nas tshegs med du mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu bzhi bco lnga tsam la dgon pa'i bya ba than thun mdzad dgos byung*/ phyis gsung las/ bar der don med yun ring du 'das gsung*/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa la skyi ston 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan ya rtser phebs pa'i lam zhor la/ glo bo steng du phebs pa dang mjal/ 'phreng ba skor gsum sogs kyi lag len dang chos kyang mang du gsan/ de rjes mar phebs dang yang mjal nas/ gsang sngags kyi chos sna mang po dang*/ tshad ma bsdus pa mkhyen pa mdzad/ de rjes kyi ston 'jam dbyangs kyi drung du phebs par bzhed nas/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gcig pa la gcig por bros nas phebs/ sngar yang rab sa 'byor pa can yin pa dang*/ lam du 'brog pa'i khyis zhal ras la rmugs pa dang*/ bshul thag ring ba sogs kyi shin tu 'o brgyal bar byung yang*/ thugs kyi brtan pa ma zhum/ ngal dub che ba yab yum gyi bka' bcag pas lan dgongs te/ la kha cig nas/ yab yum bzhugs pa'i phyogs su phyag dang bshags pa mang po mdzad pas de phyin chad bde bar byung*/ de nas sa skyar kyi ston 'jam dbyangs kyi drung du phar tshad mngon pa gsum dus gcig tu bslabs pas/

grogs rnams kyi gcig la dril ba 'thad zer yang*/ ma gsan par gsum po'i steng du spyod 'jug sngags chos 'ga' yang bsnan/ lo phyed gnyis nas/ gzhung bzhi char 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i tshig don mtha' dag thugs su chud nas/ bshad gsar mdzad pa'i chas sgrub pa la rta nag tu phebs/ slob dpon rin ye'i drung du zla ba gsum tsam bzhugs/ rde'u'i bcud len sogs kha zas rgyud gcod kyi gdams ngag spyod bzhin du/ byams pa'i chos lnga'i bshad pa tshar gcig gsan/ de rjes bshad gsar mdzad/ bka' rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs sher phyin gyi mdo rnams yud tsam gsan pas thams cad thugs su chud/ dbus gtsang gi sde phal cher du grwa skor la phebs pas/ mkhyen rab kyi rtsal dang*/ rig pa'i rnam 'gyur bzang zhing*/ sher phyin 'bum pa sogs mdo sde du ma'i tshig mtha' dag thugs la byang bar bzhugs pa dang*/ gzhung che chung gang la yang thogs pa med par mkhyen pa rgyas pas/ thams cad kyis kun mkhyen rang du 'dug ces bsngags pas/ kun mkhyen gyi mtshan de dus nas kyang thogs/ spyir mdo sngags ky-i chos gsan pa'i bla ma sum cu lhag cig mnga' mchog tu kyi ston 'jam dbyangs la/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung che chung dpag tu med pa dang*/ dbang bskur rang yang zur bka' bdun cu tsam gsan/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i phyogs la yang*/ dang por bla ma 'di'i drung du dbang rgyud man ngag thams cad la shin tu mkhas par mdzad pa yin/ 'chad nyan zur chos pa yang lo shas mdzad/ chos lung tshogs pa'i mkhan chen byang sems bsod nams grags pa la bsnyen rdzogs zhus shing*/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa gzhung 'grel dang bcas pa ma lus pa gsan cing mkhyen nas/ sku btsun pa'i mthar thug par bzhugs/ bar skabs der yul du phebs/ yab yum sogs dang mjal/ sngon bka' bcag nas dbus gtsang du phebs pa la bzod gsol byas/ mi dgyes med par mdzad/ lo gcig tsam bzhugs/ slar sa skyar phebs/

dgung lo sum cu pa la jo nang du don gcod gcig la phebs pas/ sgrub tshugs la thugs dad song*/ de nas lha sa dang 'tshur phu sogs su phebs/ chos rje rang byung pa dang chos kyi gsung gleng mang du mdzad/ rang byung pas rje 'di'i lung rig gi zhal ya ma thegs kyang*/ mngon shes bzang po mnga' bas/ khyed la lta grub dang chos skad da lta'i 'di bas kyang ches bzang ba cig myur du 'ong*/ zhes lung bstan/ dgung lo so gcig pa la jo nang du phebs/ mkhas btsun chen po la spyir dbang dang gdam pa mang du gsan/ sbyor drug la nyams 'khrid mdzad/ dmigs pa zhu ba'i skabs ma gtogs su dang yang mi 'phrad par mkha' spyod bde ldan du bzhugs/ sor sdud bsam gtan gyi nyams rtogs mthar phyin pas/ bla ma'i gsung nas mgyogs khrid bya gsung ba la/ gol le skyong bar zhu zhus te sgom par mdzad pas/ srog rtsol mthar phyin pa'i rtags rgyud nas bshad pa bzhin mnga'/ de nas lha sar smon lam mdzad cing*/ yer bar thog gcig thugs dam pa la bzhugs/ yang yar phebs te/ skyid phug du bla ma kun spangs chos grags pa la/ 'grel chen tshar gcig gsan nas gsungs/ mkhas btsun chen po'i gsung gnang bas/ dge bshes lnga cu tsam la rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa rgyas pa tshar gcig gsungs/ de nas bla ma'i bka' nan chen pos gdan sar phebs/ mkhas btsun chen po shin tu dges nas/ lo gnyis su nye ba zhig nyin mtshan med par/ dbang lung 'khrid bshad pa sogs/ bla ma nyid la mnga' ba'i chos thams cad stsal/ spyir kyi ston 'jam dbyangs dang*/ mkhas btsun chen po la chos gsan pa ni mtha' yas te/ mi tsam 'dzin pa yang dka'o/ /gzhan stong gi lta sgom khyad par can ni/ mkha' spyod bde ldan du bzhugs pa'i tshe thugs la 'khrungs pa yin kyang*/ lo shas shig gzhan la ma gsungs/ gdan sar phebs nas lo shas nas/ sku 'bum chen mo'i rmang 'dings pa dang*/ bzang ldan gong gi chos khrir bzhugs/ bshes gnyen dam pa bcu lhag la/

snying po'i mdo bcu'i bshad pa rang bzhed rtsal du ston nas rgyas par gsungs/ gzhan stong ston pa'i gsung rab than thun kyang mang du mdzad/ dpe rnams dang chos skad phyogs thams cad du khyab pas/ mkhas pa phal gyi blor ma shong*/ dngos su 'bel gtam rtsod pa zhus pa rnams/ rgya mtsho la kha ba babs pa bzhin du song bas/ dngos su mjal ba rnams grub mtha' la nges shes dang*/ bla ma la dad pa thob pa sha stag byung*/ ring nas ngag lon dang rtsod yig bskur ba rnams la chos dang mthun pa'i lan mdzad pas/ nges pa rnyed/ phyis grub mtha' de rtsod bral du song nas/ phyogs bzhi'i dge bshes du mas bskul nas/ nges don rgya mtsho sogs yig cha che ba rnams mdzad pa yin/ mchod rten chen mo bzheng pa'i tshe/ srog chags shin tu mang ba la ljags sngags mdzad/ se gol rtog pas/ srog chags gcig kyang med par song zhing*/ nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyi khengs/ chu med pa la/ bca' lung gi phu chu nar gyis thon/ gzhal yas khang gi thog phubs dang*/ gdugs kyi thog phubs kyang nyi ma re re kho na la khel/ rlung shin tu che ba dang*/ char zhong che ba byung res la bden stobs brjod pas/ 'phral nyid du zhi ba kho na byung*/ chos khri'i khar chos gsung ba dang*/ bzo bo rnams kyi sar bkod pa mdzad pa dang*/ gzims chung du thugs dam la bzhugs pa sogs/ sku lus kyi bkod pa gsum gsum dus gcig tu 'byung ba ni mang pos yang yang mthong*/ sku'i bkod pa brgyad dus gcig tu 'byung ba yang 'ga' res mthong*/ snga phyir jo nang dang*/ phug mo chos rdzong dang*/ spyi bar phug gi brag gi ngos mis ye mi thar pa mang por yud kyis phebs nas/ mchod rten mang po bzhengs/ la la da lta yang snang*/ thog ma jo nang du phebs pa'i skabs nyid na mda' nas yar phebs pas/ nam mkha' la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gzigs/ de nas bzung yi dam zhal gzigs pa ni grangs las 'das te cher cher yang mi mdzad/

'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang mi lab pa bzhin yod la/ gur gyi mgon po dang*/ rnam thos sras bran bzhin 'khol/ phyag mchod thugs dam mdzad res kyi/ rigs gsum mgon pa dang*/ 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*/ sman bla dang*/ byams pa rnams re mos kyi 'byon/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang*/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang*/ sdom pa che chung dang*/ rdo rje phag mo dang*/ rdo rje dbyings la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gzigs pa yang grangs las 'das/ bde ba can gyi smon lam mdzad pa'i tshe/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams dngos su gzigs pa dang*/ gzims khang bde ba can du gu ru'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ slob dpon pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa mngon sum du byon nas shis brjod mdzad pa dang*/ mchod rten bzheng pa'i las la zhugs tshad bde ba can du 'gro ba'i mtshan ma gzigs/ spun gsum du bzhugs skabs/ thugs dam gyi lha jo bo bhu g+ma la rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/ 'ja' 'od la bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi gzugs shin tu gsal ba nub phyogs nas byung ba dang*/ me tog gi tshogs kha dog sna tshogs pa mang po snyon med du babs/ nam phyed sku 'bum nang du chu shor ba sogs 'phran bu rnams kyang 'phral 'phral mkhyen cing*/ gong ma yon mchod kyi mnga' thang 'gyur ldog dang*/ rgyal khams kyi 'gyur ldog rnams kyang ji skad gsungs pa bzhin thog tu khel/ hor gyi spyan 'dren 'byung ba yang snga mo nas dgongs/ spyan 'dren byung ba'i tshe/ nying ro dang*/ phar phug dang*/ na dum sogs su dben pa kho na bsten pa lo bzhi tsam mdzad/ phyis rgyal pos lung bzang po gnang ste/ phebs mi dgos par byung nas/ shin tu dgyes te dgon par phebs/ de la rje 'dis jo nang gi gdan sa lo bcu bdun mdzad ring*/ gtso bor jo nang nyid du bzhugs shing*/ sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa rgya cher spel/ sku 'bum bzheng pa dang*/ gsung sgrogs dang*/ mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/

mkhas pa du ma 'dus pa la/ mdo sngags kyi dbang dang gzhung bshad rgya cher stsal/ tshogs pa yang sgrub pa snying por byed pa kho na rang yang nyung dus su stong tsam re 'tshog cing*/ spyir tshogs pa nyung dus su yang nyis stong tsam re 'du ba byung*/ mang ba la tshad med/ mchod rten bzheng pa'i las ka su rem pa dang*/ rgyu tshogs gtong phod su che ba la dge sbyor yang shin tu bzang bar byung*/ chos rje 'di la zab lam gyi 'khrid zhus pa la/ dge sbyor gyi sne ma zin pa ni gcig kyang med/ mu ge byung ba'i skabs/ slob ma kun la dka' thub rigs mang du gnang*/ dpon slob kun gyis mi zas spangs/ gsol chas thams cad 'phongs pa rnams la gnang*/ phyis chos rje thugs sras klu bas lo tsā ba dang*/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal bas gdan sa mdzad pa'i ring*/ dben gnas nges med kyi ri khrod mang por phebs shing*/ phal cher ni thugs dam la bzhugs pa dang*/ zab lam gyi 'khrid 'debs pa'i 'gro don nyid gtso bor mdzad bar bar du chos gsung ba dang*/ rten bzheng pa dang*/ yul so so'i lha khang la zhig gsos mdzad pa yang shin tu mang*/ ngam rings su chos sde btab ste bshad nyan gyi grwa btsugs/ der snyung ba zhig gis rkyen byas/ zhag bcu gnyis kyi ring sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dang*/ yi dam kyi lha bgrang bar mi dpyod pa zhal gzigs/ rin chen sding gi lcags zam 'dre gdug pa zhugs pa zhigathugs rtog mi mdzad na bsnoms par zhu zhes bdag pos phul ba la/ 'dren thag btang mtshams/ lcags kyi tshu kha nas bka' shog bsgrags pa tsam gyis/ pha phyogs kyi lcags thag rang chad la song ste/ tshur phyogs kyi zam rngur du phung gi byung ba sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas mang*/ dbus dmag yod pa'i skabs shigazhag shas blo sbyong kho na'i chos gsungs shing*/ bzod pa'i bsngags pa 'ba' zhig mdzad/ chos rang bzhugs thog dmag rgya tsam slebs/ sku la mda' rdo mtshon cha sna tshogs 'phangs kyang*/

cung zad kyang ma skyon cing g.yo med du bzhugs/ de nas dad pa skyes te bshags pa phul/ sku tshe'i smad la nub chos lung*/ 'u yugasnye mo/ gnam stong lung sogs rim pas brgyud nas/ khyad par lha sar phebs nas zla ba bcu gcig bzhugs/ dbus phyogs kyi bla ma slob dpon dge bshes dpon skya skye bo thams cad kyi zhabs la gtugs/ gang phebs thams cad du zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi 'khrid dang*/ skye bo'i tshogs la sems bskyed dang*/ yig drug gi chos kho na gnang*/ lha sar bzhugs ring gdon gyi gnod pa la bka' shog bsgrags pa tsam gyis phan pas/ bka' shog zhu ba nyin re bzhin shin tu mang ste/ mang dus brgya brgya tsam byung skad/ zab lam gyi 'khrid lan bdun gnang ba la/ 'khrid grwa snga ma rnams la brgya tsam/ nyis brgya tsam/ lnga bcu tsam ci rigs pa yod cing*/ 'khrid rting ma 'khrid mo cher grags pa la/ dam po 'debs pa stong dang brgyad brgya lhag tsam byung*/ grangs su ma bcad pa la zab lam sgom mkhan dpag tu med de/ sprang po tshun chad kyang chos la dad pa skyes nas/ las srang rnams su dben gsum sgom pa dang*/ skye bo stong phrag mang po la mchog dbang gong ma gnang bas/ mi rnams la lta ci smos srang ga'i khyi tshun chad la ye shes phebs pa'i rnam 'gyur mang du byung*/ gzhan yang dus 'khor gyi rgyud 'grel chen mo tshar gciga'abum gyi bshad pa tshar gcigadabang mdor bstan tshar gnyis/ nā ro 'grel chen dang*/ sems 'grel chung ba tshar gnyis/ dbu ma bstod tshogs tshar gsum/ snying po'i mdo bcu dang*/ nges don rgya mtsho sogs mang du gsungs/ snye mo nas 'di'i bar la srog rtsol gnang bas nyams rtogs tshad du phyin pa yang nyis brgya lhag tsam byung*/ phyir phebs pa'i tshe/ phyag 'bul bar 'ongs pa'i rta khrom mi khrom rkyang thang sgang la mi shong ba tsam byung*/ de nas kyi smad dang*/ yar 'brog dang*/ nyang stod sogs su rims gyis phebs nas/

de kun du yang zab lam gyi 'khrid mang du gsungs/ sham po rtse lnga la bde gshegs snying po don rtogs pa mang du 'byung zhes lung bstan/ thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa bu ston chen po dang 'bel gtam mdzad par bzhed na'ang*/ bu ston chen pos rtsod pa mdzad ma nus zhes grags pa yang don la gnas/ snga dus bu ston chen pos jo nang gi sku 'bum gzigs par bzhed nas/ mnal lam gzung ste phebs pas/ jo mdar phebs pa na/ kun mkhyen chen pos phaṭa ces gsungs pas mnal sad de gzigs ma thub sogs kyi lo rgyus yod/ gang phebs thams cad du sems bskyed dang*/ yig drug gi lung zhu ba dang*/ dge bsnyen pho mo zhu ba/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs zhu ba sogs kyang rgyun mi 'chad par byung*/ de nas jo mo nang du phyag phab nas lo gnyis su nye ba na/ gzugs sku dbyings su bsdu bar mdzad de/ zhag bdun du thugs dam ma grol ba'i skabs/ bar phug nas 'jad kyi bar gtsang po nyis ldab du bri/ thugs dam grol ba'i tshe byang chub kyi sems dbu gtsug nas lud pa'i skabs/ jo mdar ja sbyor gcig tsam gyi yun gtsang po gyen du log nas chad/ de bar la mi 'ga' res 'gro 'ong byas/ sku mi 'da' ba'i sngon lo lnga dang tsam nas bshang gci rgyun chad pa dang*/ snga mo nas gtum mo'i bde drod kyi 'ur langs pa la nyin mtshan dang thun thun mtshams med/ ma zos bkres med zos kyang 'ju/ zhes pa'i tshul gyis/ res 'ga' zhag grangs mang por gsol ba mi gsol ba nyung ngu tsam gsol ba yang mdzad/ nub chos lung du skya ser mang po la bsnyung gnas dkar po phyogs brgyad 'bogs ba mdzad skabs/ gug pa re'i bar du gsol ja sun re gsol ba tsam ma gtogs/ zla ba phyed la gsol ba kham gcig kyang ma gsol te/ sku nyams stobs gzhan pas bzang bar byung*/ mtshal gung thang du phebs nas/ zhag bdun bzhugs pa'i skabs/ nyin re'i nang du tsha dro mchod pa zhu mkhan mang dus bcu bcu tsam dang*/

bdun brgyad re 'khor mor byung ba kun la yang*/ de kun gyi blo kha tshim pa'i phyir gzhan pas lhag par gsol ba mdzad pas/ res 'ga' mi nyi shu tsam re'i zas kyi tshad tsam gsol/ yang ma 'byongs pa'i rnam pa ye ma byung ba dang*/ sa skya'i sgog rar dbang bskur mdzad pa'i ye shes dbab pa'i rol mo phyi rol gyang 'chag pa'i mis tshor ba la yang ye shes phebs pa dang*/ dbang bskur mdzad tshad la ye shes phebs pa dang*/ sha grag seng sogs skyes bu dam pa du ma zhal mthun par rigs ldan gyi sprul par lung bstan pa dang*/ 'chims blo bzang grags pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi skur dngos su gzigs pa yang yang byung ba dang*/ nye gnas nam mkha' byang chub kyis 'jam dbyangs dngos su mthong ba dang*/ bcom ldan rdo rje snying po dang*/ snang ba dag pa'i sgrub pa pho mo mang pos sku la mtshan dpe rdzogs par mthong ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa mngon gyur du mnga'/ don du ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa yin pas/ rigs ldan pad+ma dkar po dang gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo nyid yin pas/ dam pa so so'i gzigs snang la byung ba yang de snang zhing*/ rnam pa gcig tu na/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ rnga bo che'i mdo dang*/ sprin chen po'i mdor lung bstan pa/ li tsā bi gzhon nu 'jig rten kun gyi mthong na dga' ba zhes bya ba/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ ka yo ri'i rgyud du ston pa'i mtshan 'chang ba la dge slong du gyur ste/ mdo sde du ma gsal bar byed ces ston pa'i mtshan ni/ kun mkhyen ces yongs su grags pa ste/ chos rje 'di nyid lung bstan par dngos slob rnams bzhed pa yang*/ don la gnas pa yin zhing*/ chos rje nyid kyis kyang don gyi zhal gyi bzhes par mngon no/ /de'i phyir/ sku gsung thugs dang mdzad pa gsang ba mtha' dag de bzhin gshegs pa kho na'i spyod yul lo/

/chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa 'di la/ rigs ldan kyi sprul pa yin pa'i snyan grags che ba dang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos kyi mnga' bdag chen por mngon sum du bzhugs pa la rten/ dus mnyam gyi dge bshes phal mo che zhig gis/ chos 'di dang 'brel ba'i man ngag ci rigs pa ma gsan pa med pa lta bu yin/ dbang rgyud man ngag rdzogs par gsan pa yang stong phrag mang po dang*/ dbang dang 'khrid cha tshang ba thob pa khri phrag brgal ba dang*/ mchog dbang gong ma dang*/ so sor sdud pa'i 'khrid gsan cing nyams myong skyes pa ni bgrang bar mi spogs pa tsam yod par grags shing*/ spyir bstan pa sgo thams cad nas rgyas par mdzad/ sgos su bod kyi ri sul thams cad rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi sgrub pa pos khyab pa dang*/ bshad nyan gyi grwa thams cad du/ snying po'i mdo dang rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos las brtsams/ phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i gtam/ bde gshegs snying po seng ge'i sgras khyab par mdzad der/ rnga bo che'i mdo las lung bstan pa bzhin du/ lo brgyad cu lhag gi bar du de lta bu'i rgyun gnas par gyur la/ de rjes lta ba mtho ru re zhing drang don kun rdzob la lhag par zhen pa'i ngang tshul can/ snyan grags dang*/ dbang thang dang*/ 'khor tshogs bsdu ba'i bgo skal can mang du byon pa la rten/ sngon bzhin gsal bar ma gyur kyang*/ dus kyi tha ma'i tha ma da lta'i bar du yang*/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgom pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i gtam srol kha ma nub tsam yod cing*/ bar skabs su mang du byung ba ni dam pa 'di kho na'i drin no/ /yang dam pa 'dis dang po sa skyar 'chad nyan la thugs gzhol ba'i tshe/ ka chen bzhi dang*/ rigs tshogs lnga/ dbu ma 'jug pa/ byams chos phyi ma bzhi rnams lan mang du gsungs/ snga phyir gzhung 'phran mi gcig pa yang bcu tsam gsungs/ phyis sgrub pa la thegs nas/ star chags du skyong ba'i 'chad nyan gyi grwa 'dzugs pa ni ye mi mdzad/

don gnyer mkhas pa mang po 'dus pa la/ byams chos sde lnga dang*/ dbu ma bstod tshogs dang*/ 'bum dang*/ snying po'i mdo rnams dang*/ 'grel chen dri ma med pa'i 'od sogs sems 'grel skor gsum dang*/ dbang mdor bstan kyai rdo rje nā ro 'grel chen rnams yang dang yang du gsungs/ dbu ma rtsa ba dang*/ spyod 'jugabaslab btus/ kyai rdor rgyud gsum/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'phreng ba/ gsang 'dus sgrol gsal/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum sogs kyang*/ lan re re gnyis gnyis gsungs/ so so'i 'dod pa dang mthun par/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang rnams dang*/ bde dgyes gsang 'dus gshin rje gshed/ rdo rje dbyings dang*/ rta mgrin phur pa sogs gsang sngags gsar rnying gi dbang zur bka' yang mang du gnang*/ gdams ngag 'khrid tshul tha dad pa yang mang du gsung mod kyi/ gtso bor sher phyin gyi mdo dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ snying po'i mdo dang rgyud bla ma/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang khrid/ sems 'grel skor gsum gyi bshad pa dang bcas pa rnams rtag tu gsung ba lta bu yin zhing*/ theg pa mtha' dag gi nges pa'i don yang de dag las brtsams te gsung ngo*/ /'on kyang res 'ga' ni sgrub pa kho na la thugs gzhol bar yang mdzad/ chos gsung ba'i dus na yang*/ gzigs rtog bshar sbyang*/ thugs bsam sogs mdzad mi dgos te/ chos grwar phebs pa'i dus dang*/ zhal bkod sogs gang dgos pa'i dus de ka ma gtogs/ zab mo'i rnal 'byor kho na la bzhugs so/ /sngon bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal rdzogs par nan tan dang bcas pas tshar gcig gzigs/ de kas don thams cad ma 'dres par thugs su chud/ sku 'khor 'ga' zhig gis/ bla ma pa'i mkhyen rlabs 'di la/ mkhan chen bu ston pa'i gzigs rtog gi thugs rtsol dang*/ 'chad nyan la thugs gzhol ba 'di yod na/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa lta bu gcig yong bar gda' zhus pas/

spyir chos 'di rnams bslabs pas go ba kho na rang yang min/ tshogs sgor du ma nas bsog cing*/ bsgoms na go ba lags/ da lta snying po bsdu ba'i skabs 'dir/ sgrub pa kho na phan yon che ba yin mod gsung ngo*//de ltar na dam pa 'di la spyir slob ma'i tshogs mtha' yas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dgongs pa skyong ba'i slob ma rang yang shin tu mang*/ gtso bor gyur pa/ lo tsā ba blo gros dpal dang*/ sa bzang lo tsā ba ma ti paṇa chen gnyis la thugs sras rnam gnyis su grags/ kun spangs chen po chos grags dpal bzang zhabs tog shin tu che/ 'dis kyang lo tsā tshad du phyin pa mkhyen/ chos rgyal phyogs las rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen rin chen tshul khrims/ zhang ston bsod nams grags pa/ mkhas grub dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ yar lung pa chos dpal mgon po rnams/ 'phrin las kyi rgyun rgya cher skyong mkhan yin zhing*/ de dag las/ chos rgyal phyogs las rnam rgyal ni/ ya tshe rgyal po'i bla mchod bla chen zhig gi sras su 'tshar ka'i rong du sku 'khrungs/ lo shas gsang ba'i tshul du bzhugs/ de rjes blo bor byon/ yab dang khu bo sogs las sngags chos mang po dang*/ dbu ma rtsa 'jug gnyis spyod 'jug dang bcas pa mkhas par sbyangs/ gzhon nu'i dus de nyid du tshogs pa rnams la bshad pas/ ngo mtshar du gyur/ de nas dbus gtsang du 'byon par bzhed pa la/ re zhig bla mas bkas ma gnang yang*/ yid kyis yang yang gsol ba btab ste/ gcig pur bros nas byon/ gung thang du dpang lo chen po dang mjal/ sa skyar byon te/ de lo 'chad nyan rkang tshugs par mi 'dug nas/ brag ram du byon/ lo gcig phar tshad dbu gsum la sbyangs pa mdzad pas mkhas par mkhyen/ de nas dbus kyi gung thang du byon/ lo gnyis kyi ring sbyangs pa cher mdzad/ gzhung lugs thams cad la mkhyen brgyas/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa la dbus gtsang gi grwa sa thams cad du grwa bskor mdzad/ sku gzhon nu gzhung lugs thams cad la mkhyen pa rgyas shing*/

thugs gsal ba dang*/ brjod pa gtsang ba dang*/ rtsod pa bzang ba la 'gran gyi do med du grags/ 'tshal pa'i dpon dga' bdes/ phyogs las rnam rgyal du mtshan gsol/ 'tshal gung thang gi zur chos kyang mdzad/ slar yang brag ram du byon pa zhig la/ jo nang du kun mkhyen chen po dang mjal nas/ gzhan stong gi grub mtha' la lung rigs kyi brtag dpyad byed dgos dgongs te phebs pas/ kun mkhyen sku 'bum la bskor ba mdzad pa dang mjal/ 'bel gtam mdzad par zhus pas shin tu dgyes te/ bla brang du zhag bdun tsam gyi ring la 'bel gtam shin tu 'phel bar mdzad pas/ gzhan stong gi grub mtha' sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa/ chos thams cad kyi chos nyid du nges pa rnyed/ gzhan stong gi 'gog byed kyi rtsod pa rnams ni/ rnam par rtog pa'i ri mo tsam las don la mi gnas par mkhyen/ kun mkhyen chen po la mi phyed pa'i dad pa 'khrungs/ de skabs chos 'brel ci rigs pa gsan nas thegs/ slar dus kyi 'khor lo rgyud sogs thugs la bzung nas jo nang du phebs/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang zhus/ zab lam gyi 'khrid bskyangs pas/ nyams rtogs phun sum tshogs par 'khrungs/ rgyud 'grel la sbyangs pas tshegs med par mkhyen/ kun mkhyen chen po la dbang dang mdo sngags kyi bshad pa dpag tu med pa gsan/ lo mang por mchod g.yog kyang mdzad/ bu ston chen po la yang*/ phar phyin dang mtshan brjod gsan/ shug phug tu bshad sgrub kyi grwa chung du skyong zhing lo shas bzhugs/ ngam ring gi chos dpon mdzad nas phar tshad la bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad/ 'chad nyan 'phel bar bzhugs skabs/ lo tsā ba blo gros dpal sku 'das nas/ jo nang gi gdan sa lo drug mdzad/ ngam ring gi chos dpon dang jo nang gi gdan sa lhan cig tu bzhag nas/ se mkhar chung du gtso bor thugs dam la bzhugs/ de nas log 'ga' nas kun mkhyen chen po gshegs/ de rjes mi ring bar/ 'tshal gung thang dang*/

yar klungs sogs dbus kyi phyogs rnams su dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos rgya cher spel/ phyis sku tshe'i smad kyi dus su/ slar yang jo mo nang gi gdan sa mdzad/ mngon mkhyen thogs med mnga'/ gtsang nas se khar chung du phebs pa zhig la/ nam srod khyer ba la mdog chu'i 'gram du phebs/ 'khor g.yog rnams kyi gnas tshad du bzhugs par zhus pa la/ 'phral du thegs pa'i zhal ta mdzad de/ de 'phral ko ba sogs gang yang med par sku rkyang chu'i pha khar phebs/ de rjes 'khor g.yog rnams kyang nam phyed de khar ko ba la rten nas yongs pas/ nam langs ma theg bltas dus/ chu'i pha kha thams cad dmag gis khengs/ de 'dra ba'i lo rgyus mang*/ dgung lo bdun du don gsum pa la/ thams cad kyi sku dog che zer zhing*/ sku khams bag tsam bsnyung ba la/ rim gro mdzad par zhus pas/ de yang rung ste/ lo brgyad cu gya gcig gi bar bsdad pas chog gsung ba dang*/ bdun cu don dgu pa'i gzhug la/ sku khams shin tu bsnyel ba'i skabs/ da lo mi 'chi ba'i rang dbang yod gsung*/ brgyad cu pa la sku khams shin tu bzang ba la/ da kun sku khams bzang bar gda'/ lo shas blo bde zhus pas/ da lo khams bzang ste/ da bzod nges par 'gro dgos pa yin gsung*/ thams cad thogs tu khel/ de sogs yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga'o/ /de la zhal slob 'gro don can shin tu mang yang*/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal ni/ khams pa'i dge bshes nya dar ma rin chen zhes bya ba'i dbon po yin/ chung ngu nas mkhyen rab shin tu che/ chos rje kun mkhyen chen po dang yang yang mjal/ dgongs don thugs su chud cing*/ mos gus chen po zhig yin pa/ dgung lo nyi shu skor la/ phyag zhabs gong ste 'byon ma thub/ klu gdon gyi rtog pa byung*/ kun mkhyen chen po sa skyar phebs pa zhig la/ grogs kyi khur nas byin rlabs zhu ru byon/ byin rlabs gnang*/ ljags btab tsam gyis bsnyung gzhi las 'phral du grol/

phyis mdo sngags kyi gzhung thams cad la mkhyen pa rgyas shing rig pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal yun ring du bsten/ nyams rtogs kyang mthar phyin pa brnyes/ dus 'khor sogs mdo sngags kyi chos mang po gsan/ sa skyar 'chad nyan yun ring du mdzad/ sku tshe'i smad la blo gsal drug brgya tsam gyis bskor nas/ rtse chen gyi chos sde btab/ bshad sgrub gnyis ka shin tu 'phel bar mdzad do/ /grub chen kun blo ni/ shar kha ba'i sku rus su 'khrungs/ phar tshad/ mngon pa/ 'dul ba/ dbu ma sogs mdo phyogs rnams dang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bshad sgrub rnams nya dbon chen po kho na la gsan/ gzhan bla ma dam pa mang du bsten cing*/ dbang gdams ngag mtha' yas pa la mnga' brnyes/ rgyal po'i rigs su 'khrungs kyang srid la ma chags pas/ spa gro la sogs pa yul theg ring po dang*/ bas mtha' rnams su sgrub pa kho na la thugs gzhol/ rang gi dpon rigs rtse shar nub gnyis kyi 'khrug par dus mi bde ba la/ phan bde'i bkas khyad par mdzad/ sku tshe'i smad la 'khrul zhig chen por bzhugs shing*/ bu ston chen po'i skye ba yin par grags so/ /'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po ni/ 'khrungs sa la stod byang pa/ rtsa ba'i grwa sa bzang ldan yin/ sa skya sogs grwa sa grags che ba phal cher du byon/ mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal pa las sa skya pa'i chos rnams gsan/ grub chen kun dga' blo gros la dus kyi 'khor lo sogs zab don mtha' dag gsan/ si tu rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyi bla mar bkur/ nyang stod kyi chos sde gsar ba'i chos dpon mdzad/ jo nang pa'i grwa tshang gsar du btsugs/ phyis rtse shar nub gnyis kar gyis gus pas btud/ chos sde gnyis char dang jo nang gi gdan sa yang mdzad/ grub mtha'i chags sdang las/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang dpon slob kyis byad kha byas pa yang bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems dang*/

rdo rje'i bzlas pa spel bas/ byad kha phyir log ste/ mkhas grub dge legs dpon slob rnams mi ring bar grongs/ lha chen bzang ra dam la btags/ de sogs ya mtshan ba'i lo rgyus mang*/ bla ma sa skya ba chen po'i sprul pa grags so/ /mkhas grub nam mkha' chos skyong ni/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mdzad sa dang*/ rtsa ba'i grwa sa grwa tshang chen mo yin/ kun mkhyen nam bsod chen mo la mtshan nyid kyi gzhung rnams mkhas par sbyangs/ slar 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po'i chos grwar byon/ chos dang gang zag thams cad la dad mos 'khrungs/ mtshan nyid kyi gzhung rnams la mkhas nyan mdzad/ gzhan stong gi grub mtha' rnams la nges pa gting nas tshugs/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa zhus te nyams rtogs kyang shin tu bzang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud gzhung la yang mkhas par sbyangs/ ngam ring 'tshal gung sogs 'chad nyan chang chung 'ga' re'i sar phebs/ rtse shar nub gnyis dang*/ khyad par seng ge rtse bas yon bdag gi mthil byas/ rtse chen dang jo nang gi gdan sa yun ring du mdzad/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa gnyis kar bzung*/ sku 'bum chen mo'i chos 'khor bcu gsum gser zangs kyi g.yog par mdzad do/ /paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang ni/ grub mtha' rtsa ba sa skya ba yin/ mus pa rab 'byams pa thugs rje dpal bzang gi grwa sar slob gnyer mdzad/ brgya sder 'chad nyan yang lo shas tshugs pa byung*/ bdag chen rnam rgyal grags pa'i slob ma shangs ston pa bya ba la/ lhun sdings su dus 'khor byang lugs de shin tu mkhas par sbyangs/ rgyal ba nam mkha'i mtshan can la sbyor drug gi man ngag jo nang ba'i rang lugs 'di snga dus cig gsan pas nyams rtogs bzang por 'khrungs pa yin/ 'bras spung gi dgon pa btab nas 'gro don cung zad mdzad do/ /de la lo chen rat+na bha dras zhus/ de la rje btsun grol mchog gis gsan/ de la mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtshos gsan/ de'i drung du dngos kyis thob ste/

'di man ngag kho na'i brgyud pa yin na'ang*/ nyams rtogs kyi rgyun ma chad pa yin pas rtsis su byas la/ yang dbang rgyud man ngag gsum kar bka' cig pa'i dbang du byas na/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po la/ 'jam dbyangs chos dbang gis gsan te/ mkhas pa de ni/ spyir mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs thams cad la mkhas shing*/ khyad par phar phyin jo nang kun mkhyen chen po'i rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa 'di dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo la shin tu mkhas/ sbyor drug la nyams rtogs bzang po mnga'/ gur gyi mgon po zhal gzigs/ bzang ra sogs 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre dregs pa mang pos zhabs la btud/ dang por khang gsar gi 'chad nyan mdzad cing*/ phyis chos sde chen po'i gdan sa yun ring du mdzad do/ /de la dbon chen chos seng ge gi zhus/ de la mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes kyi zhus/ de la mkhas grub byams pa lhun grub kyis gsan/ dngos kyis mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes la ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang tsam mnos/ byams pa'i mtshan can la/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la rten dbang yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ rim pa gnyis kyi bshad pa rgyud 'grel dang bcas pa thob bo/ /yang 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs chos dbang*/ mkhan chen kun dga' dpal 'byor/ mkhan chen dkon mchog rin chen rnams brgyud nas/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho'i drung du/ mngon rtogs dpag bsam ljon shing dang*/ dkyil chog ye shes rgya mtsho klags chog gi steng nas dbang rdzogs par zhus/ gzhan yang sbyor drug gi lung sogs than thun zhus pa'i bla ma 'ga' re yod de/ brgyud pa de rnams ni jo nang ba'i lugs yin la/ bu ston rin po che'i lugs kyi dbang rnams yongs su rdzogs par/ rdo rje slob dpon chen po dpal ldan chos bzang la mnos shing*/ yan lag drug pa'i gdams pa grub thob zhi ba sbas pa'i lugs dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang dang*/

lha nyi rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang rnams/ slob dpon pur+ṇa badz+ra las kyang thob bo/ /zhes pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos skor gyi byung khungs nyer mkho bsdus pa 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas chos lung byang rtser sbyar ba'o/ /dge legs 'phel//
